lateCoverage.statement: role capacity parity is exactly frontier-height parity up to fixed H
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: Fixed integer H and h; kappa=(H-h) mod 2.
lateCoverage.derivation: Reduction in Z/2 gives subtraction=addition. Fixed H makes the recoding invertible.
lateCoverage.limit: Checker sets k=H XOR h before testing the same equality; this is a finite recoding sanity check, not an independent implementation check.

lateCoverage.statement: role phase plus relative depth anchors absolute row parity
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: A represented residual cell has r=h_c+d, and phase stays attached to that same local role.
lateCoverage.derivation: Reduce r=h+d modulo 2 and substitute IA-001. Local column permutation does not change vertical row.
lateCoverage.limit: Does not identify a canonical column with a fixed physical column or establish CPC ownership/deadline semantics.

lateCoverage.statement: for a surviving cell in a moved column, kappa and d parity both toggle, preserving anchored row parity
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: One legal move in the tracked column; the same absolute-row cell survives, and its role correspondence is transported across recanonicalization.
lateCoverage.derivation: h increases by one; d decreases by one; both parities toggle, so their XOR is fixed.
lateCoverage.limit: Does not prove quotient transition closure, survival of every residual, or identity of a canonical role index before/after movement.

lateCoverage.statement: ZOE is the additive quotient preserving zero/nonzero and count parity
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: Counts are nonnegative integers for a fixed descriptor, combined by multiset addition.
lateCoverage.derivation: Zero iff both summands zero; parity adds modulo 2. The three-state quotient is closed and inherits commutative associativity/identity.
lateCoverage.limit: Addition only: ZOE is not a cancellative group and does not define deletion/cofactor dynamics or a WDL composition law.

lateCoverage.statement: XOR is lawful on normalized oddness while presence composes by OR
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: Descriptor identities are already aligned; combine multiplicities by addition.
lateCoverage.derivation: Oddness is the additive map to Z/2; positive support is the additive map to Boolean OR.
lateCoverage.limit: Changing or merging descriptor identities first changes the coordinates; XOR is not established as final game-value composition.

lateCoverage.statement: ZOE is the coarsest count quotient required to preserve both zero predicate and parity
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: The quotient must recover both predicates n=0 and n mod 2 on all nonnegative integers.
lateCoverage.derivation: Each output pair is one of (0,0),(1,0),(1,1); any preserving quotient cannot merge distinct pairs. The ZOE kernel is an additive congruence.
lateCoverage.limit: No proof that these are the only game-relevant observables, nor global MSS optimality among arbitrary structural encodings. On smaller restricted count domains the image may have fewer than three realized states.

lateCoverage.statement: rank parity is reconstructible from geometry, descriptor phase checksums, and ZOE oddness
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: Fixed W,H; components partition every physical column, including isolated/full columns; equal descriptors preserve their capacity-phase checksum; standard player0-first alternating no-pass game.
lateCoverage.derivation: XOR h_c = WH mod2 XOR XOR kappa_c; group columns by components and descriptor multiplicity; even repeated checksums cancel. Mover is rank mod2 under the start/turn contract.
lateCoverage.limit: Checker verifies bit algebra and widths 1..10, but does not execute component coverage, descriptor grouping/canonicalization, or mover schedule. These are necessary premises of the proof.

lateCoverage.statement: exact rank, rank mod 3, and arbitrary scheduler state are not recovered by IA-LATE-007
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: Statement means the preceding parity derivation establishes no stronger rank information.
lateCoverage.derivation: A theorem recovering rank mod2 alone says nothing about exact rank or mod3 recovery from the full descriptor.
lateCoverage.limit: Do not reinterpret this as a proof that the full signature can never recover exact rank, mod3 or schedule on a restricted domain.

lateCoverage.requiredPremises: Valid ZOE Boolean coordinates satisfy O=>P.
lateCoverage.derivation: At O=0 both sides zero; at O=1 valid states have P=1, so PO=O.
lateCoverage.limit: This reduces coordinate monomials, not scalar behavior or a native game-theory interaction order.

lateCoverage.statement: GF(2) polynomial degree is not a semantic interaction degree because native OR expands into higher ANF degree
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: GF(2) ANF over chosen P/O encoding is distinguished from a chosen native operation vocabulary.
lateCoverage.derivation: OR(a,b)=a+b+ab; a native OR of three arguments has a cubic ANF. Algebraic degree therefore is not representation-independent game interaction degree.
lateCoverage.limit: Does not prove observed OOO correction is caused by OR, or remove the bounded necessity of degree>2 in the frozen feature vocabulary.

lateCoverage.statement: affine joint target dimension 2 means both output columns are independent modulo affine span, not that exactly two unique structural syndrome generators exist
lateCoverage.requiredPremises: The joint target rank gain is actually 2 relative to the declared affine span, not merely two individually nonzero gains.
lateCoverage.derivation: dim((A+span(y0,y1))/A)=2 says the two cosets are independent; it neither selects a unique basis nor identifies two unique structural syndrome terms.
lateCoverage.limit: Identity checker does not replay target ranks. Joint gain 2 must remain pinned to separate bounded decoder evidence; two individual gains of 1 alone would not suffice.

findings.statement: Universal target-necessity prose omits the equal-source guard present in the true native formulas.
findings.evidence: Native roots explicitly assume a0=a1. SC-IA021 only derives that at least one shared endpoint must split. Source-only split countermodel satisfies all four projected edge equations with target merged.
findings.retain: Target-only splitting is sufficient; target splitting is necessary when source phase/identity is fixed. Retain guarded native formulas and valid SC-IA021/026/037/051.
findings.correct: Restore fixed-source guard in human bodies, normalized bodies, admission exact_body_preserved claims and QU-SC-001. Do not infer target asymmetry for all refinements.

findings.statement: One sample relative-parity=0, phase-difference=1 falsifies direct equality (also homomorphism-only laws), not arbitrary functional determination.
findings.evidence: SC-IA057 has only SC-IA056 as premise; native 211057 is literally the same body as 211056. No homomorphism-only candidate restriction appears in that premise or scope. The sample admits two total Boolean functions, both f(0)=1.
findings.retain: Exact observed inequality and falsification of the identity/direct-parity law or any group homomorphism Z2->Z2. No claim that relative parity is in fact globally sufficient.
findings.correct: Narrow prose to direct equality/homomorphism laws or explicitly enlarge domain to self-pairs and derive a same-input/different-output witness. Do not import unlisted identity-pair comparisons silently.
findings.scopeClarification: This audit does not refute the non-factorization conclusion on all ordered route pairs. Adding (A,A) or (B,B) gives (0,0), which collides with (A,B)=(0,1). The current single-sample argument and native body omit that domain/derivation; their stronger prose is not verified by the supplied body.

findings.statement: The complete verifier checks a recorded stopping decision; it does not compute inference-family saturation or equivalence of every prose/native assertion.
findings.evidence: Verifier asserts status strings and empty new_assertions/support_refinements/qu_refinements arrays; inference rule file supplies named families and prose authority, without a candidate grammar, executable enumerator or exact normalization equivalence. It also performs substantial independent-in-function finite replay, raw incidence checks, GF(2) certificates, delimiter/free-variable/root checks; those should not be dismissed.
findings.retain: 31 source roots and 64 IA roots as a represented inventory; successful finite replay where separately recorded; operational frozen-packet stopping decision as historical reviewed evidence.
findings.correct: Call closure reviewed, rule/premise/normalization-relative and not logically exhaustive. F01/F02 require support/body corrections before renewing a zero-refinement stop claim. Root presence and true guarded formulas do not prove stronger prose bodies.

findings.statement: Late identity PASS covers seven algebra families, not all eleven complete statements or representation premises.
findings.evidence: Minimality, stronger-rank nonclaim, and target-rank interpretation have no direct tests. Phase check partly checks constructed identities; rank checks do not verify all-column component coverage or physical-to-descriptor transport. The prose derivations do supply the elementary mathematics.
findings.retain: All eleven late statements remain valid with the recorded guards/nonclaim interpretations.
findings.correct: Keep proof reasoning distinct from finite implementation sanity checks; do not call this checker a native IsoGraph primitive-closure or all-IA theorem certificate.

relativeParity.conclusion: Observed x!=y disproves y=x and every group homomorphism Z2->Z2 (which must map 0 to 0), but permits an arbitrary function with f(0)=1 and does not alone disprove y=f(x). A second same-input/different-output sample is required for arbitrary non-factorization.
relativeParity.premiseAudit: SC-IA057 lists only SC-IA056, whose body is the observed parity pair. Neither that body nor the SC-IA057 scope specifies homomorphism-only candidate functions.
relativeParity.possibleRepair: Explicitly admit diagonal route-pairs with relative parity 0 and phase difference 0, or restrict the assertion to inequality/direct-parity/homomorphism-law falsification. The original sole premise does not state that enlarged comparison domain.

enlargedAllRoutePairs.conclusion: Including diagonal pairs gives a genuine same-input/different-output witness, hence arbitrary relative-parity factorization fails on all route pairs. The singleton f(0)=1 countermodel does NOT fit this enlarged domain.
enlargedAllRoutePairs.nativePremiseAudit: The inspected kernel binds route A and B separately and defines the single transporter 197502 as composition of 197500 and 197501. It does not declare a general route-pair-to-relative-transporter/difference relation including diagonals; SC-IA057 sole premise is the fixed-pair SC-IA056 observation. General finite-map closure can supply the missing elementary derivation, but it is not the stated proof/body.
